info.name: Flowers Backend API
info.description: Gateway-facing Flowers API (all public routes). Run Health -> Auth Login first; the login test script stores accessToken. Suggested order for a full walkthrough: Roles & Users -> Catalog -> Procurement -> Inventory (Receive lot) -> Files -> Cashier -> Sales -> Assembly -> Analytics/Audit. Analytics/Audit are eventually consistent (outbox ~1s + consumer poll). Docs: backend/docs/api/README.md
